To be eligible, you generally need at least six months in your current role, sustained performance, and evidence that you are operating at the next level [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. Common promotion evidence for customer-facing roles often includes items such as improved customer outcomes, measurable process improvements, mentoring, decisions that prevented waste, and repeated judgment in ambiguous situations [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. Your manager will then submit a promotion packet for calibration with People Operations and the department leader [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process].
